title: BSF
description: BSF: Fantasy, Tech, Steam Punk, and everything in between. Enough content to keep you busy for longer than the typical 2 weeks of minecraft.
body:
# BSF – Big Stink'n Fish 
![Intro Image of BIG STINKN FISH](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bec04393cd72e22a654ccb1675de9466a3ddd12d.webp)

**The 1.21.1 NeoForge modpack that actually runs great.**

Stunning shaders, maximum FPS, animated mobs and gear, deep tech/magic/exploration, and cosmetics for **days**


 ### What You Get
- **TOP tier visuals** — Iris shaders + Sodium + other tweaks  
- **Living world** — GeckoLib/AzureLib animations, dynamic bosses, animated armors & tools  
- **Build & automate** — Create contraptions, Mekanism tech, Simple and uber complex.  
- **Explore & conquer** — new biomes, dimensions, structures, tough bosses  
- **Dripped Out** — hats, backpacks, jetpacks, curios layers, elytra variants  
- **QoL everywhere** — better inventory, minimap, dynamic lights, leak fixes  
 

Ready for a pack that looks insane and **feels** insane (in a good way)?

**Download BSF now and make Minecraft feel _Stinky_ again.**

IF ANYONE HAS IN DEPTH KNOWLEDGE ON 1.21.1 MODPACKS pls help ill take any help i can get holy moly is this stuff hard. Anyways download and enjoy.
